note: Reviewed exceptions for the map logos chosen by scripts/fetch-institution-logos.mjs, keyed by Wikidata item. `pick` names the collected candidate to use (its URL or part of it), `url` adds a file the automatic search did not find, `same` gives a merged or historical institution (or a faculty) the logo of its successor or parent, `skip` lists source URLs (or parts of them) that gave a wrong, generic or unreadable image, `reject` leaves the institution with initials. Each entry gives the institution, the reason and the review date.
